origin: cwe/121/c Key Principles: sizeof(buffer) is only the array size in the declaring scope; helper functions need an explicit capacity

finding.name: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
finding.summary: A helper concatenates attacker-controlled first and last names into a caller's fixed 32-byte stack buffer without receiving or enforcing its capacity.

trap: Adding sizeof(destination) checks inside append_display_name(), replacing only the final strcat(), or truncating names silently. In the helper, destination is a pointer; the caller must pass the real capacity and the helper must reject or report oversized combined names.
must_preserve: Valid first and last names still produce the same 'first last' display string in out. Oversized combined names are rejected or reported instead of being silently truncated into a different badge value.
